description: Source code for malfunction indicator, including blinking error codes via MIL, thread management, and error handling for OBD-II diagnostics in an automotive firmware project.

methods.name: blink_digits
methods.description: Blinks the specified number of times with given duration to represent a digit.

methods.name: DigitLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits in an integer.

methods.name: DisplayErrorCode
methods.description: Displays a multi-digit error code via blinking sequence.

methods.name: mfiThread
methods.description: Main thread function that periodically displays error codes.

methods.name: testMil
methods.description: Adds sample error codes for testing.

methods.name: isMilEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the malfunction indicator is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: initMalfunctionIndicator
methods.description: Initializes the malfunction indicator system and creates the main thread.
